projects.name: Finz Accounting Data Pipeline
projects.summary: Built a full accounting data platform for a take-home engineering challenge: raw bank transactions in, classified and reviewed cash-basis P&L out, synced to QuickBooks Online, and reconciled line-by-line against QuickBooks' own P&L to prove the numbers agree to the cent.
highlights: FastAPI backend with MongoDB, a deterministic vendor/keyword classification rules engine, and a Gemini API fallback for anything the rules don't catch, constrained to a strict JSON schema.

Layered duplicate detection using a unique Mongo index on bank transaction ID plus a SHA-256 fingerprint fallback; verified against 5 planted duplicates in a 200-row test dataset with zero false merges.

Full QuickBooks Online OAuth integration with idempotent syncing (183 transactions posted, 0 failed against a live sandbox) and a reconciliation engine that diffs the app's P&L against QuickBooks' own report down to $0.01 tolerance.
Validated results matched the assignment's known-correct figures exactly across all 17 account-level P&L lines and a 3-month net profit of $68,180; 30 automated tests passing.
Containerized with Docker and deployed live on Render.
